notes: R2 amendment landed. Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock: truck123d gains exactly the one authorized workspace-internal truck-assembly path-dep edge (lock diff = 1 line, the truck123d package entry), PB-004 precedent. New truck123d/src/assembly_emit.rs is the client-side emission: emit_step_assembly(&[AssemblyPart], &[AssemblyContactIntent]) -> Result<AssemblyReport, Refusal> builds a truck_assembly::assy::Assembly graph (node shape = SolidHandle, node attrs = name + recorded rows; no edges — contacts are recorded, not placements) over the landed read-only DAG/assy surface, then serializes each node as one STEP PRODUCT (AP214 Part 21 text, deterministic fixed index numbering) whose description carries a typed serde NodeRecord {solid_kind, intents}; read_step_assembly is the round-trip partner (line-based parser of the emitted subset, STEP simple-string unescaping, serde-typed decode; unreadable/foreign text or an empty part/duplicate-name/unknown-endpoint/control-char domain refuses typed Refusal::Empty). INTENT-RECORD SHAPE (the record the r1 SPEC_GAP named missing): AssemblyContactIntent { node_a: String, node_b: String, kind: EvidenceRowKind::Intent, note: String } with EvidenceRowKind a single-arm enum serde'd 'intent' — a certified contact cannot even be expressed, so recording can never be confused with resolution (H-6/recorded-not-resolved). Each intended contact is recorded as an evidence row on BOTH participating nodes (deterministic, symmetric). Solid representation: opaque client SolidHandle { id, kind } mirroring the PyTruckSolid shape; python.rs not widened; no kernel type crosses. TEAPOT NODE CENSUS (test teapot_body_spout_handle_assembles): the fixture parses the real showcases/tables/teapot.json through tables::TeapotTable (bridge table), expresses body/spout/handle as three simple prismatic facade sessions from table numbers (body Cylinder {belly-radius, rim-height}; spout Polygon{r0 square} + Extrude{rise}; handle Box{handle_radius}), certifies each in-envelope/non-constructive through run_facade, then assembles: read-back report lists exactly 3 nodes in insertion order (body, spout, handle) carrying the recorded intents — body records both junction intents (body-spout, body-handle), spout and handle each record their body junction, every row typed INTENT; STEP text carries one PRODUCT per node. assembly_emits_n_solids_step: 3 solids -> STEP whose read-back asserts 3 nodes and the full round trip is lossless (read.nodes == emit.nodes). contact_intents_recorded_until_bie: rows appear on both named nodes, typed INTENT (single-arm kind), lossless through emission->STEP->read-back incl. a quoted note. API deviation: none beyond the R2-authorized write-set growth; emission stays pure-text (no file I/O, no python surface — PB-007 wires the facade). Determinism: node order = insertion order (truck-assembly Vec order), fixed indices, no hashes. H-1: new module declares the crate lint denials and never unwraps/expects/panics/indexes in shipped code; no float comparisons, so no H-3 markers. Done-when gates all green via the PATH queue shim: cargo fmt --check -p truck123d clean, cargo clippy -p truck123d --all-targets -- -D warnings zero findings, cargo test -p truck123d 11/11 (lib 4, pb_assembly 3, pb_facade 4, doc 0), cargo check -p truck-assembly clean. Operational: embedded-interpreter tests need python314.dll app-local in target/debug/deps (PB-004 result note) — it was missing on this tree and was copied from the local CPython 3.14 core dir before the test gate; no source change.
